purpose: Provide dataclass-backed domain models for commerce operations: Product inventory control, Customer balance management, Order status transitions with event logging, and CartItem validation. Expose validated, stateful operations used by catalog, payments, repository, services, and CLI layers.
components: Product: entity; stock reservation and release with validation
Customer: entity; balance management with debit/credit and spend checks
Order: entity; status transitions (paid/cancelled) and timestamped event log
CartItem: value object; SKU and quantity validation
internal_structure: The module groups four dataclass-based domain types. Each class encapsulates its own state and validation. Internal collaboration occurs within classes only (e.g., Customer.debit calls Customer.can_spend; Order status methods call Order.add_event). There are no cross-class calls within this file. Methods mutate instance fields and may raise ValueError; Order uses datetime.now(timezone.utc) for timestamps.
module_mechanism: On import, it defines dataclass-based models without side effects. At runtime, consumers construct these models and invoke their public methods. Methods validate inputs; on success they mutate in-memory state and, for Order, append timestamped events; on invalid inputs they raise ValueError. The module’s public surface is the set of exported classes.
inputs: Order(order_id, customer_id, items, total_cents, status, events, created_at)
outputs: Product: mutates stock; reserve/release return None
Customer.can_spend: returns bool indicating spend eligibility
Order: mutates status; appends event entries with timestamps; methods return None
CartItem.validate: returns None on success; signals failures via exceptions
side_effects: Appends to Order.events with timestamped entries
Reads current time via datetime.now(timezone.utc) for event timestamps
errors: ValueError: qty must be positive (Product.reserve, Product.release)
TypeError: invalid amount comparisons during validation in Customer.credit
ValueError: only created orders can be marked paid (Order.mark_paid)
ValueError: paid orders cannot be cancelled here (Order.mark_cancelled)
AttributeError: events does not support append (Order.add_event)
NameError: datetime or timezone is not defined (Order.add_event)
